title: Miri Standard API Graph
description: Schema for api-graph.json - AST-derived API relationship graph. Only structure that can be evidenced from source is represented: nodes carry their kind, edges carry a declared relationship. Scored or inferred values (centrality, usage frequency) and synthesized usage workflows are deliberately NOT part of this contract - a generator must not invent them.

nodes.description: API components as graph nodes, keyed by component name. Keys are dotted qualified names (e.g. Greeter.greet) so a node can be joined to the same key space sdk-manifest.json api_index uses; a bare name is the module-level form of the same grammar.

file.description: Source file this component is defined in, relative to the package root. An AST fact, so it carries no inference beyond what the source states (Generation Invariants §5.4).

module.description: Dotted module path this component is defined in. An AST fact.

relationship.description: Type of relationship, derived from the source (inheritance, return type, call site)

methods.description: Methods involved in the relationship, when evidenced from source
